so.text: The surplus was visible in the monthly report by spring, months before the close and before the next budget was voted.

notes.text: And FY2025’s unbudgeted emergency cabling went to the Finance Committee as a Reserve Fund vote, in the open.

so.text: Credit where the ledger shows it: upkeep was kept inside its budget on every account, and an emergency went to a public vote.
